raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
DeepSeek V4 unified-KV attention on gfx1250:
- bf16 sparse prefill uses `pa_sparse_prefill_opus`
- sparse decode passes `kv_splits` sized for the gfx1250 decode tile
- C4 / C4 fp8 indexer / C128 compressors fuse compress with norm/rope/store (`compress_norm_rope.cuh`)
- V4 Pro defaults to unified KV with AITER decode and allows the fp8 two-pool KV

Depends on sgl-project/sglang#48064.

<!-- results -->
### Accuracy
GSM8K (200 questions, greedy), DeepSeek-V4-Pro: TP4 0.975.

### Performance
Setup:
- Model: DeepSeek-V4-Pro, BF16 KV cache, DSPARK speculative decoding (block 6, 1 step)
- Parallelism: TP4 (`--tp 4`, CP prefill + CP decode attention)
- Step time: torch profiler on rank 0, GPU time per step; decode = 8 steps at 4 running requests (VERIFY = target verify, DRAFT = DSPARK draft), prefill = one EXTEND step of an ~8k-token prompt (TP4) / 4k (EP4)
- Comparison: with vs without this PR, same image and node, all earlier PRs of the series applied

Profiler step time (without -> with):

| step | without | with | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| decode VERIFY | 16.97 ms | 15.65 ms | -7.8% |
| decode DRAFT | 1.86 ms | 1.82 ms | -2.0% |
| prefill EXTEND | 191.1 ms | 183.0 ms | -4.2% |

Serving (`python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-range-ratio 1`, fresh random prompts):

| input/output, concurrency, prompts | output tok/s | mean TTFT (ms) | mean TPOT (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 32k/1k, C4, 32 | 611.8 -> 659.7 (+7.8%) | 2478 -> 2347 (-5.3%) | 3.97 -> 3.64 (-8.3%) |
| 1k/1k, C1, 32 | 399.2 -> 410.9 (+2.9%) | 173.3 -> 172.2 (-0.6%) | 2.34 -> 2.27 (-3.0%) |
| 1k/1k, C4, 96 | 1204.3 -> 1198.5 (-0.5%) | 312.0 -> 316.7 (+1.5%) | 2.98 -> 2.99 (+0.3%) |
<!-- /results -->

+def gfx1250_mxfp8_prepare_weight(
+    weight: torch.Tensor, weight_scale: torch.Tensor, block_size: List[int]

+    n, k = weight.shape
+    if n % 16 or k % 128 or weight_scale.dtype != torch.float32:

+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4 import unified_kv_gate as env_gate

+

+
+
+class TestGfx1250V4UnifiedKvGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        env_gate._gfx1250_v4_unified = False
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        env_gate._gfx1250_v4_unified = False
+
+    def test_v41_does_not_enable(self):
+        maybe_enable_gfx1250_v4_unified_kv("deepseek_v41")
+        self.assertFalse(env_gate._gfx1250_v4_unified)
+
+    def test_explicit_tilelang_does_not_enable(self):
+        with patch.object(
+            envs.SGLANG_HACK_FLASHMLA_BACKEND, "get", return_value="tilelang"
+        ):
+            maybe_enable_gfx1250_v4_unified_kv("deepseek_v4")
+        self.assertFalse(env_gate._gfx1250_v4_unified)
+
+    def test_v4_auto_enables_only_on_gfx1250(self):
+        with patch.object(
+            envs.SGLANG_HACK_FLASHMLA_BACKEND, "get", return_value="auto"
+        ):
+            maybe_enable_gfx1250_v4_unified_kv("deepseek_v4")
+        if is_gfx1250_supported():
+            self.assertTrue(env_gate._gfx1250_v4_unified)
+            self.assertTrue(is_unified_kv_triton())
+        else:
+            self.assertFalse(env_gate._gfx1250_v4_unified)
+
+
+class TestGfx1250V4UnifiedKvFp8Gate(CustomTestCase):

+
+    def setUp(self):
+        is_unified_kv_fp8.cache_clear()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        is_unified_kv_fp8.cache_clear()
+

+            patch.object(env_gate, "is_gfx1250_supported", return_value=True),
